2607.13707.title: The Test Oracle Problem in Synthetic LLM-as-Judge Corpora: Disappearance, Distortion and a Validation Protocol
2607.13707.paper_summary: Studies of bias in LLM-as-judge systems typically build synthetic corpora by prompting an LLM to generate a hallucinated answer to pair with a factual one, then presenting both to a judge. We report a case in which this generation step silently failed, and use it to argue that the failure mode is structural rather than incidental. In a multilingual (Turkish/English) faithfulness-judgment corpus, a decoding-budget parameter shared between judging and generation calls truncated one producer's hallucinated answers to a few words. The resulting items produced a large, statistically robust effect: a 32-point cross-lingual collapse in one judge's selection accuracy, replicated from N=50 to N=500, explained by a three-layer mechanistic account, and confirmed by a controlled producer-swap experiment, none of which was real. The effect vanished to ceiling once the shared parameter was corrected, and only manual reading of the raw generations, not any aggregate statistical check, exposed the fault. A second measured bias (Markdown-formatting preference) was not fabricated but distorted by the same fault, its magnitude and in one case its sign shifting with stimulus length, a mode aggregate metrics cannot distinguish from the first. We frame the underlying vulnerability using the test oracle problem: corpora whose negative examples are LLM-generated carry no mechanical way to verify item integrity, while corpora built by deterministic perturbation of a gold answer carry an item-level oracle for free. A positive control supports this claim directly: an analogous fault injected into a minimal perturbation-based corpus is caught with 100% accuracy by a zero-cost, zero-human gold-to-negative string comparison. We close with a validation protocol, derived from our own case, for analysts working in the oracle-less regime that we argue describes most contemporary multilingual LLM-as-judge corpora.
2607.13707.paper_summary_zh: 研究 LLM 作為裁判系統中的偏見通常是通過提示 LLM 生成一個虛構的答案來構建合成語料庫，以便與一個事實性的答案配對，然後將兩者呈現給裁判。我們報告了一個生成步驟靜默失敗的案例，並用它來論證失敗模式是結構性的，而不是偶然的。在一個多語言（土耳其語/英語）忠實性判斷語料庫中，判斷和生成調用之間共享的一個解碼預算參數將一個生產者的虛構答案截斷為幾個單詞。產生的項目產生了一個大的、統計上穩健的效果：一位裁判的選擇準確性在跨語言上下降了 32 點，從 N=50 重複到 N=500，這可以通過三層機械解釋來解釋，並通過一個控制的生產者交換實驗來確認，這些都不是真實的。當共享參數被修正後，這個效果消失到上限，只有手動閱讀原始生成的內容，而不是任何聚合統計檢查，才揭示了這個錯誤。第二個測量的偏見（Markdown 格式偏好）並不是虛構的，但被同樣的錯誤扭曲，其大小和在某些情況下其符號隨著刺激長度而改變，這種模式的聚合指標無法與第一種區分。我們使用測試神諭問題來框架潛在的脆弱性：那些負面示例由 LLM 生成的語料庫沒有機械方式來驗證項目完整性，而通過對金標答案的確定性擾動構建的語料庫則免費攜帶項目級的神諭。正控制直接支持這一主張：注入到最小擾動基礎語料庫中的類似錯誤可以通過零成本、零人力的金標到負標字符串比較以 100% 的準確率捕捉。我們以一個驗證協議作結，這是從我們自己的案例中得出的，旨在為在我們認為描述大多數當代多語言 LLM 作為裁判語料庫中工作的分析師提供指導，這些語料庫缺乏神諭。
2607.13707.author: Serkan Ballı et.al.
